name: 司潔妮
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.
schedule:
Week 1 (9/10) Course Introduction & What Makes a Good Presenter
Week 2 (9/17) The Big Picture: Presentation Structure
Week 3 (9/24) Knowing Your Audience
Week 4 (10/1) Organizing Your Content
Week 5 (10/8) Designing Slides That Work
Week 6 (10/15) Body Language and Voice
Week 7 (10/22) Opening and Closing Strong
Week 8 (10/29) Handling Questions and Midterm Preparation
Week 9 (11/5) Midterm Presentation (Day 1)
Week 10 (11/12) Midterm Presentation (Day 2) and Feedback
Week 11 (11/19) From Presenting to Meeting: What Changes
Week 12 (11/26) Meeting Roles and Agenda
Week 13 (12/3) Joining a Discussion: Useful Phrases
Week 14 (12/10) Giving Opinions and Disagreeing Politely
Week 15 (12/17) Informative vs. Persuasive Speaking
Week 16 (12/24) Making Decisions Together and Final Preparation
Week 17 (12/31) Final Presentation (Day 1)
Week 18 (1/7) Final Presentation (Day 2) and Course Wrap-up
scorePolicy:
* 選修本課程，請務必準時到班上課；第一堂課請勿缺席。
* Any student who accumulates FIVE unexcused absences in the semester class will receive a no-credit status. 無故缺席 5 次，即無法獲得本課程學分。

(1) Class Performance (CP), including:
 - Midterm Presentation: 20%
 - Final Presentation: 30%
 - Quiz, Participation & Assignment: 30%
 - Attendance: 20% (-5% for each absence)

(2) School-wide English Proficiency Exam (EPE)
----
Overall score = [80% x CP] + [20% x EPE]
